economy: US dollar 103.92 (-0.27% today, +0.03% this week): a weaker dollar usually helps gold.
US 10-year yield 4.89% (-17 bp today): falling yields usually support gold.

Gold is moving against the dollar and yields today: that move is driven by something else (flows, safe-haven demand) and can reverse.

history_note: Levels like this held about half the time over 2 years of data, so this is a place to watch, not a trade on its own.
